end.summary:
- Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere.
- Matched everyday objects to 3D shapes using a cake tin, dice, gas cylinder and matchbox.
- Identified cylinder as having two flat faces and one curved surface.
- Identified cube as having six square faces; teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised 3D shape names and matching objects to shapes. Ishita explained that a cylinder has two flat faces and a curved surface, and that a cube has six square faces. They repeatedly asked to see pictures or drawings, so using real objects or clear pictures at home may help; ask them to name each shape and point out its faces and curved surfaces.
